predictions: P-A (window-integrated Ep, falsifiable): Ep is monotonically decreasing (Lu+2018 class H), so our window [-1.548,+30.618] s - which is SHORTER than the catalog flnc [-2.048,+60.416] s but LONGER than Lu's [-0.83,+16.30] s - must give a window-integrated Band Ep ABOVE the catalog's 151 keV and BELOW Lu's first-bin 327 keV. Predict 150 <= Ep <= 240 keV. FALSIFIED if Ep < 140 keV or > 260 keV, or if MINOS fails to bound it.

P-A2 (high-energy tail, falsifiable): beta is well measured with the BGO in every external frame (catalog -2.220 +0.107/-0.086; Lu's four bins -1.93 to -2.31), so models carrying a high-energy power law must beat the exponential cutoff. Predict Band (or SBPL/DSBPL) beats CPL window-integrated, and predict our fitted beta lands in -2.5 <= beta <= -1.8. FALSIFIED if CPL wins by dAIC >= 10 window-integrated, or if beta falls outside that band with MINOS-bounded errors.

P-A3 (straight power law, falsifiable): catalog PL is rejected at REDCHSQ 2.048/362 against ~1.08 for the curved models. Predict PL is the WORST of the base models in every block by dAIC >= 20. FALSIFIED if PL is ever within 10 AIC of the block winner.

P-B (hard-to-soft, falsifiable and the sharpest test here): Lu+2018 measured monotonic softening 327 -> 186 -> 152 -> 103 keV over [-0.83,16.30] s and class H with kE = -0.77 +/- 0.14. Predict our per-block Ep sequence is monotonically DECREASING across the time-resolved blocks (no rise, no tracking), that the FIRST block's Ep exceeds 240 keV, and that a log Ep vs log(t+t0) slope computed on our blocks lands within 2 sigma of -0.77. FALSIFIED by any intensity-tracking pattern (Ep rising with flux), by a first-block Ep < 200 keV, or by a slope outside [-1.05, -0.49].

P-C (blackbody, falsifiable, UNPUBLISHED-DECISION class): nobody has ever proposed a thermal component for this burst - there is no published answer to memorize, which is exactly what makes it useful. The stale archival prior nevertheless fired the union rule in the time-integrated block (Band+BB over Band by dAIC 11.15, kT = 36.7 +/- 2.5 keV) and in 1-2 of 3 time-resolved blocks. Predict the union rule fires in the integrated fit again, and in >= 1 time-resolved block, with kT in 15-50 keV. ***L25 TRAP, DECLARED IN ADVANCE***: at kT ~ 37 keV the blackbody's nu-F-nu peak sits at ~3.92*kT ~ 144 keV, essentially ON TOP of the Band Ep (151-162 keV) - this is precisely the degenerate regime where a 'BB' can be a re-parametrised low-energy break. Any BB claim here MUST clear the L25 xb-vs-kT check and the L28 per-NaI residual-coherence check before it is called a photosphere, and the b0-background QC flag above must be carried into that judgement. FALSIFIED if the union rule fires in ZERO blocks including the integrated one, or if kT lands outside 10-70 keV.

P-D (two-break, falsifiable): the archival era found no two-break signal (best LRT_DSBPL_SBPL = 7.48, best dAIC = 3.5, and the time-resolved DSBPL breaks railed at xb = 361-672 keV = the L8 seed artefact). The catalog's own SBPL break (96.81 keV) sits BELOW Band Ep (151 keV), which is the ordinary one-break picture. Predict DSBPL does NOT win by dAIC >= 10 in any block. A DSBPL win WOULD be a genuine unpublished-discovery candidate and must survive the L8 default-seed restart before it is believed - the archival non-detection is a LOWER LIMIT, not evidence of absence, because L8/L9 hardening postdates it.

P-E (temporal, falsifiable): predict our 50-300 keV T90 reproduces 82.7 +/- 3.1 s to within its error (there is no pre-trigger emission - T90START = +1.536 s - so this is a clean comparison, unlike the D4 bursts), and that our lag measurement is POSITIVE (soft photons later) with a 100-300 vs 25-50 keV value near 1.5 s. FALSIFIED by a negative lag, or by |T90 - 82.7| > 3 sigma once band and detector set are matched (50-300 keV, n1+n2+n5 - note the duration catalog includes n1, which we do NOT approve at 63.85 deg).

P-F (frame trap, procedural, not falsifiable): our window covers ~36% of the T90 span (all of T50). Because Ep softens monotonically, ANY Ep/fluence diff against the catalog MUST re-align interval AND detector set first. The published ladder to place ourselves on: Lu bin1 327 > pflx 216/231 > Lu bin2 186 > flnc Band/Comp 151/186 > Lu bin4 103 keV. Never quote a burst-level Ep without its interval.

scoring_note: This burst is a high-value AI-Scientist specimen precisely BECAUSE the literature stops short: three papers use it as a row in a timing sample and none fits a model beyond Band. Its Stage-1 decisions (detector set, window) are externally corroborated - the GBM spectral catalog independently chose b0+n2+n5 and Shao independently chose n2 - so the DECISIONS we can score here are the unpublished ones: the block count, the BB verdict under the union rule (with the L25 degeneracy declared in advance), and the two-break verdict. There is no published answer to memorise for any of the three.
